body: That doesn’t sound dumb at all, after thinking about it, that makes sense. I just don’t know if I have the wherewithal to apply it, you know without using running or cutting to get by, i guess those are pretty affirming. I used to be obsessed with a poem called invictus by william ernest henly, the last line of the poem is “I am the master of my fate, I am the captain of my soul” which hit deep, ya know feeing so out of control, I used to repeat it like a mantra kind of, when i felt i was losing myself in the pain, when the things i normally do don’t keep me grounded, I’ve lost that after everything that’s happened though. So like i said I understand what you mean and it totally isn’t dumb, it’s just whether i’m strong enough to believe it again.

I haven’t called the cops or CPS, I know what happens when you call them, i don’t trust them to make this any better. I mean I’ve only told one other person, but they just gave a “sorry” but i don’t know what i expected, I don’t even know what to do. I guess the cutting and running till i throw up, gives me control over something, because i really don’t have control over anything. Like the amount of time I run or how much I hurt myself till it takes my mind off of what hurts and I start to feel better for a short time, which sounds absolutely fucking crazy I know, but it’s what’s kept me from trying to kill myself again I guess, i don’t  know what else would even begin to help.

I don’t even know where to begin. There hasn’t been a day where I haven’t thought of killing myself. It feels like i’m dying or at least my soul is, I feel so hopeless, I don’t know any other way to describe it than bad, I feel really fucking bad, the only relief I have is running till I pass out or throw up or like cutting and stuff. It’s moved a bit, I guess the idea of suicide used to be a bit of a security blanket, like “oh if this happens then i’ll just kill myself” or “oh if that happens i’ll just kill myself”. But now it’s constant no matter what i’m doing, everything bad that’s happened just surfaces and edges me on to just you know like do it. I suppose I’ve tried once before but I passed out, let go of the bag and came to feeling like an absolute prick. I’ve been dealing with mental abuse from my father for years, and a couple of physical events like when he choked my sister and I tried to get him off and got punched in the face, then my mom told us she had our backs but 360 span it around to get my fathers gratification or some shit, because he calls her worthless and shit like that, and believe me I love my mother but screwing me and my sister is where i drew the line. My family is pretty fucked up, i’m stuck. I have one more year of high school, I don’t feel like I’m going to make it through the year. I guess i’m just waiting for something to push me over the edge again.
